description: This Java class represents a ConceptStopWord used within the OpenMRS project for filtering common words like 'and', 'if' during search indexing. It includes fields for word value, locale, and identifiers, and provides constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ConceptStopWord
classes.description: A class representing a stop word used in concept searching within the OpenMRS system, localized by locale, with proper identification and string representation.

methods.name: ConceptStopWord()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty ConceptStopWord.

methods.name: ConceptStopWord(String value)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ConceptStopWord with a given value and the default locale.

methods.name: ConceptStopWord(String value, Locale locale)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ConceptStopWord with a specified value and locale.

methods.name: setValue(String value)
methods.description: Sets the stop word value after converting it to uppercase if it has text.

methods.name: getLocale()
methods.description: Returns the locale associated with the stop word.

methods.name: setLocale(Locale locale)
methods.description: Sets the locale; defaults to Context locale if null.

methods.name: getConceptStopWordId()
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the ConceptStopWord.

methods.name: setConceptStopWordId(Integer conceptStopWordId)
methods.description: Sets the ID for the ConceptStopWord.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Overrides method to return the conceptStopWordId.

methods.name: setId(Integer id)
methods.description: Overrides method to set the conceptStopWordId.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ConceptStopWord including its value and locale.
